_comment: Cause-tagged TJ recovery lines for the no-death knockout loop (issue #92). GameState.knock_out(cause) picks one line semi-randomly from the matching pool and the infirmary spawns TJ to speak it. Every cause MUST resolve to a non-empty pool; unknown causes fall back to 'generic'. Edit these freely — they are data, not hardcoded.
speaker: TJ

trap: You tripped something out there. Lucky it only knocked you cold — sit still while I check you over.
Whatever that was, it dropped you hard. No lasting damage. Don't go poking things you don't understand.
You set off a trap. I've seen worse, but next time, watch where you step.
asphyxiation: Your O2 was nearly gone — don't do that to me again.
You stopped breathing for a bit there. We got you back. Keep an eye on your air next time.
Another minute without air and this would've been a very different conversation. Breathe easy now.
heat: Heat exhaustion. You cooked yourself out there — fluids and rest, that's an order.
Your core temp was through the roof when they brought you in. You're cooling down fine now.
You pushed too long in that heat. Sit tight until your temperature's back to normal.
alarm: Something out there didn't want you around. You're safe now — bruised, but safe.
They carried you back in after the alarm went up. No serious harm done.
Whatever set off that alarm clipped you good. Rest up, you'll be fine.
alien_defense: Something out there didn't want you around. You're safe now — bruised, but safe.
They carried you back in after the alarm went up. No serious harm done.
Whatever set off that alarm clipped you good. Rest up, you'll be fine.
window_closed: Eli? I thought we lost you for a minute there.
You cut it too close to the jump. They pulled you through just in time — barely.
That was way too close. Destiny doesn't wait. You're back now, that's what matters.
generic: You're awake. Good. You took a knock out there — nothing that won't mend.
Easy now. You're back aboard Destiny and you're going to be fine.
Welcome back. You gave us a scare, but you'll be on your feet soon enough.
